{{Quote|Any word on Team Two?''"<br />"''Scat was captured. He is being held in the detention center.|Alexandra Winger and [[Magir Paca]]|<ref name="A Glimmer of Hope">{{JournalCite|1|A Glimmer of Hope}}</ref>}}
'''Team Two''' was a unit of the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|Garos resistance]]. [[Scat]] was a member of the unit, and was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces during a failed raid on an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] convoy in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. He was subsequently rescued from detention in the [[Imperial Headquarters (Garos IV)|Imperial Headquarters]] by [[Team Five]] and [[Alexandra Winger]].
